label: Pixel membership: 4 profiles × 5 cutoffs × 4 bucket counts × 2 named modes + original baselines
description: All 545 assets including original corpus and all supplied archive wallpapers. Native global OpenSearch ordering. New measurements include hard physical coverage, feather/core-halo effective coverage, and weighted scores across multiple hard cutoffs. Single-observer development judgments, not a held-out human study; archive wallpapers remain unjudged. Small-corpus latency is not a million-record performance claim.
